summary: Select supplied or externally generated fractional Legendre degrees and associate them with supplied coefficients or a source-defined NBI pitch-angle projection over the active loss-cone interval.

identity.relation: Mirror-ratio loss-cone state and NBI source configuration to fractional Legendre degrees and source coefficients
identity.direction: (params, optional spectrum_operator) -> degrees, source_coefficients, degree_source, legendre controls, xi_tp_mid and fractional_mode callable
identity.definition: Set R from mirror_ratio, falling back to turning_b then 2.0, and xi_tp_mid=sqrt(max(0,1-1/max(R,1e-12))). For positive xi_tp_mid use explicit legendre_degrees or call the supplied spectrum_operator(xi_tp_mid, mode_count, grid_points, backend) for degrees. Explicit source_coefficients are float-converted after shape/finiteness validation. Otherwise, for each degree nu, compute c_nu=u_nu(clip(cos(theta_NBI),0,xi_tp_mid))/max(4*pi*integral_0^xi_tp_mid u_nu(xi)^2 dxi,1e-30), using 64-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature. u_nu=a P_nu+b Q_nu is normalized by a 2x2 linear solve to u_nu(0)=1 and a centered-difference derivative zero at xi=0 with step 1e-5. The default P_nu uses a 15-term truncated hypergeometric series; the alternative is scipy.special.hyp2f1. If xi_tp_mid<=0, return empty degrees and coefficients before validating the active-branch backend or spectrum controls.
identity.model: Source-defined fractional Legendre angular NBI projection for a mirror loss cone; it does not infer degrees internally or evolve a distribution
identity.geometry: One-dimensional pitch-cosine interval from xi=0 to the mirror-ratio-derived turning boundary xi_tp_mid
identity.coordinates: xi and degree are dimensionless. nbi_pitch_angle_deg is in degrees and converted through cosine; the angle cosine is clipped to the active interval. Returned degree and coefficient arrays preserve supplied order.
identity.boundary: The mode combination is numerically normalized at xi=0; no endpoint root is checked for caller-supplied degrees. The quadrature includes interior points of [0,xi_tp_mid], and the inactive branch returns empty arrays without evaluating a spectrum.
assumptions: The caller supplies physically suitable fractional degrees or a compatible spectrum callable when no degrees are explicit; this function does not certify their loss-cone boundary roots.
The coefficient formula treats the NBI pitch as a point-source direction with the source-defined 4*pi angular normalization; external source amplitude and transport physics are not modeled.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Configuration dict holding mirror_ratio or turning_b; optional legendre_degrees, source_coefficients, legendre_terms, legendre_backend, legendre_mode_count, legendre_spectrum_grid_points and nbi_pitch_angle_deg.
inputs.units: mirror ratio, degrees and xi: dimensionless; coefficients: caller source normalization when explicit; NBI pitch: degree; terms, mode_count and grid_points: count
inputs.shape: dict with scalar controls and optional one-dimensional degree/coefficient arrays
inputs.constraints: Must be a dict. R defaults to 2.0; legendre_terms to 15 and backend to 'truncated'. In the active branch, terms converted with int must be >=2 and backend must be 'truncated' or 'hypergeometric'; explicit degrees must form a nonempty finite 1-D array. Explicit coefficients must be finite with the same shape. Other controls are converted only on their exercised branch, and unknown keys are ignored.

inputs.name: spectrum_operator
inputs.description: Caller-provided degree generator when legendre_degrees is absent in the active branch.
inputs.units: xi_tp_mid and returned degrees: dimensionless; mode_count and grid_points: count; backend: text
inputs.shape: None or callable(xi_tp_mid, mode_count, grid_points, backend) -> mapping containing degrees
inputs.constraints: Required only in the active branch without explicit degrees. It receives int-converted counts defaulting to 6 and 256 and the selected backend; returned degrees must form a nonempty finite 1-D array. The callable is supplied by the caller, not imported or validated for scientific equivalence here.

outputs.name: degrees
outputs.description: Explicit degrees or the supplied spectrum callable's degree array, in original order.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonempty in the active branch; their noninteger character and endpoint eigencondition are not checked unless later mode evaluation requires it.

outputs.name: source_coefficients
outputs.description: Explicit coefficients or NBI pitch projection coefficients paired with degrees.
outputs.units: computed branch: dimensionless in the source-defined normalized angular convention; explicit branch: caller-supplied normalization
outputs.constraints: Explicit coefficients are checked for finiteness but may share storage with the input array. Computed coefficients use the 64-node formula and denominator floor 1e-30, without a final finiteness check; empty when inactive.

outputs.name: degree_source
outputs.constraints: One of 'caller_supplied', 'scirel.kinetic.loss_cone_spectrum' or 'inactive_loss_cone'. The spectrum label is fixed even if the injected callable is not SciRel's solver.

outputs.name: legendre_terms
outputs.description: Int-converted requested truncation count used for active mode evaluation.
outputs.constraints: Default 15. The active branch requires >=2; the inactive branch reports the int-converted value without that check.

outputs.name: legendre_backend
outputs.description: Chosen P-function numerical evaluator in the active branch.
outputs.shape: scalar when active; absent when inactive
outputs.constraints: Only 'truncated' or 'hypergeometric' in the active branch. The document default denotes absence; the runtime does not return this key or a null value in the inactive branch.

outputs.name: xi_tp_mid
outputs.constraints: Computed from max-clamped R; zero enters the inactive branch. No independent finite or physical R>1 validation is performed.

outputs.name: fractional_mode
outputs.description: Callable evaluating the normalized fractional Legendre mode at a requested degree, pitch cosine and term count.
outputs.shape: callable(degree, xi, terms) -> scalar or array
outputs.constraints: Returned in both branches. Active branch closes over the chosen backend; inactive branch uses the default truncated evaluator. Invocation can raise for integer degrees, singular coefficient systems or invalid numerical arguments.

preconditions: params is a dict, and the active branch has either a finite nonempty one-dimensional legendre_degrees array or a supplied callable yielding one.
For computed coefficients, chosen degrees must make the fractional P/Q normalization solve numerically valid; the caller must use physically suitable source and mirror settings.
supported: Explicit degrees with explicit coefficients, or source-defined 64-point NBI projection onto explicit degrees.
Optional externally supplied spectrum degree generation and the inactive-loss-cone empty result for xi_tp_mid<=0.
excluded: Automatically discovering or certifying a complete fractional Legendre spectrum without a supplied spectrum callable.
Validating a source amplitude, an arbitrary source distribution, physical turning-boundary consistency, or a full Frank-Egedal pressure closure.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-dict params; absent active-branch spectrum_operator when degrees are omitted; invalid explicit degree shape/finiteness; active legendre_terms<2; unsupported active backend; or mismatched/nonfinite explicit coefficients. Float/int conversions and injected spectrum errors can propagate as ValueError, TypeError or their original exceptions. The inactive branch bypasses these active checks.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Computed coefficients can raise ValueError for integer degrees through Q, NumPy linear-algebra errors for a singular 2x2 mode system, or SciPy/NumPy arithmetic errors. No general finiteness check follows computed coefficients, and the returned fractional_mode callable can fail later when invoked.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: The projection does not iterate to convergence; its 64-point quadrature has no returned error estimate. Convergence of an injected spectrum operator is external and unchecked.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned on a raised exception. The inactive branch returns complete empty arrays and metadata rather than signaling a failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel maintains a compatible public implementation associated with a saved historical Pleiades Frank-Egedal source-projection operator. The import and old admitted-assets mapping provide development lineage, not current qualified L1 delivery or expert recognition; source and maintained implementation are not asserted byte-identical.
source_kinds: saved historical Pleiades operator descriptor and implementation mapping
SciRel direct independent hypergeometric-integral and branch contract tests

example.description: Project one explicitly supplied noninteger degree with a hypergeometric mode and check its origin, normalization and coefficient finiteness.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import project_frank_egedal_source_modes
r = project_frank_egedal_source_modes({'mirror_ratio': 2.0, 'legendre_degrees': [0.5], 'nbi_pitch_angle_deg': 60.0, 'legendre_terms': 24, 'legendre_backend': 'hypergeometric'})
assert r['degree_source'] == 'caller_supplied'
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['degrees'], [0.5])
assert r['source_coefficients'].shape == (1,) and np.all(np.isfinite(r['source_coefficients']))
assert abs(float(r['fractional_mode'](0.5, 0.0, 24)) - 1.0) < 1e-10
example.expected: The caller's degree 0.5 is retained, one finite source coefficient is returned, and the normalized mode is one at xi=0.

scope: A one-mode hypergeometric NBI coefficient at mirror_ratio=2 and pitch angle 60 degrees is compared with independent adaptive integration to absolute error below 2e-11.
The returned mode is checked at xi=0 and xi=0.2 against an independently reconstructed P/Q combination, with a near-zero centered derivative check.
A supplied spectrum callable is checked for argument forwarding and degree/explicit-coefficient preservation; the inactive branch returns empty arrays and a source label.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests establish the selected hypergeometric one-mode projection, normalization, numerical derivative, injected-spectrum branch and inactive result. They do not test the truncated default's projection accuracy, all degrees or mirror ratios, spectrum completeness, arbitrary injected operator correctness, source parity from a qualified frozen L1, expert recognition or public release.
known_limitations: No built-in spectrum generation occurs: a caller-supplied callable is mandatory when active degrees are not explicit, despite the fixed SciRel-looking degree_source label.
Integer degrees can pass input validation but fail during computed mode evaluation; explicit coefficients defer such failure until the returned mode callable is invoked.
The truncated backend, fixed 64-point quadrature, 1e-5 derivative step and 1e-30 normalization floor have no general accuracy bound.
Inactive loss cones bypass active backend, term-count and degree validation; mirror-ratio physical validity and finite computed-output checks are incomplete.
Current-version scientific expert recognition and public distribution licensing remain pending.
